latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "Video Editing with Professional" — AI-powered editing for raw footage.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB; get edits like pause removal, color grading, and background music.
- Simple onboarding: automatic backend connection and free trial with 100 credits, no account required.
- Fast cloud rendering (1-2 minutes/job), with downloadable 1080p MP4 exports.
- Covers key user intents: upload, edit, export, check credits, and view edit status.
- Comprehensive guide for workflows, error handling, and maximizing quality/speed.
